profile.headline: Sports @ Apple | Domer
profile.summary:
Santiago is a software engineer with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Notre Dame du Lac. Raised in the Bronx, he excelled academically, earning the Hipp-Beeler Scholarship and Faculty Choice Senior awards. Currently, Santiago is part of Apple’s Evolve Rotational Program in New York City, where he develops innovative iOS features for the Apple Sports App, focusing on performance, accessibility, and new functionalities.

Proficient in Swift, Python, Java, C, and TypeScript, Santiago has experience with Xcode, SwiftUI, LangChain, and React. His previous roles include Software Engineer Intern at Apple in San Diego and Software Developer at BILL in San Jose, where he worked on API development and micro-services.
Santiago has led research projects, including a multi-class segmentation project using PyTorch and HuggingFace, and developed EyeTrack, a real-time computer vision system. He is a founding member of Colorstack chapter at Notre Dame and is passionate about XR, Blockchain, and AI. 

In his free time, Santiago enjoys hiking, working out, listening to music, and learning to DJ and produce music. He is eager to connect and share ideas with others.

My school email: srodri25 {@ ~ alumni.nd.edu
Personal email: sjrodriguez.iii [@ | gmail.com
Check out my site: svntiiago.com

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer - Sports
positions.description:
Build cool sports features for Apple. 

But in other words I developed and maintained real-time sports data infrastructure powering Apple TV+ Sports, processing live event feeds from third-party providers into structured data served to millions of users. Focused on data ingestion pipelines, event-driven microservices, and platform expansion to new leagues and sports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Evolve is a 3x 8 month rotation program in the Services organization.

First Rotation - Client Engineering for the Sports App (7/2024 - 3/2025)
- Developed new iOS features, improved layout rendering performance, and implemented accessibility improvements throughout the app.
- Key Features: Motorsports [Scoreboard], Quick Actions, Accessibility Reflow, and Pre-Game Lineups

Second Rotation - Backend Engineer for the Sports App (3/2025 - 10/2025)
- Led Global Soccer Expansion, building ingestion pipelines, standings engines, and tournament support to onboard 10+ international leagues across Latin America and Europe — expanding live soccer coverage to new markets.
- Helped launch realtime the F1 data experience within Apple Ecosystem.
- Hired full time on Server Feature team

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Joined the Enterprise Education Technologies Boost Team and actively contributed to the development of customer features and internal tooling.
- Architected a swift framework that leveraged SPI's and XPC services to enhance the overall customer experience.
- Tested, screened and triaged bugs by viewing device logs and finding a clearer, defined way of reproducibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Joined the Developer Platform API team. Primarily worked on Back-end and business logic.
- Focused on splitting processes off monolith engine into scalable Lambda micro-processes.
- Implemented end to end web-hook product that would enable seamless integration between applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Open API · RESTful WebServices · Jira · Java · AWS Lambda · Micronaut

positions.title: Brand Sales Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted IBM NW's Business Automation portfolio in their development, management and execution on strategies and tactics for closing business
- Performed in-depth assessments of customer processes in order to uncover and understand the customer’s business issues, in which I generated 2 leads.
- Lead a client facing demo expressing technical capability and business value of the solution
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Automation · Communication · Project Management · Microsoft Office · IBM Cloud Pak · Sales Prospecting

positions.title: Above and Beyond Computer Science (ABCS) Fellow
positions.description:
9 Week Coding program that covered topics ranging from linked lists to tree traversals
Connected and interacted with current Meta SWE
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Systems Design · Algorithms · Data Structures

positions.title: Dark Market Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Joined a team of students and professionals interested in the data, data transfers and IT platforms related to illegal digital commerce on the Dark Web
- Researched for markets, and once a market was found, prepped a web-scraping bot to pull all the listings on the site.
- Maintained anonymity by practicing safe cyber measures, relaying on tor network, and working under a VPN.
- Worked in Linux, Python/Selenium
- For more info: https://yld.me/aPTj
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Jupyter · Selenium WebDriver · Cybersecurity · Linux · Command Line

positions.title: Electronic Trading Competition
positions.description:
- A day-long programming contest where participants compete against each other in a simulated markets.
- Iteratively and tested trading strategies on the fly.
- Placed 2nd in most profitable trading algorithm
- Built with Python

positions.title: Financial Analyst Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Created financial models for managers that monitored their respective bankers’ success on deals, and more.
- Fixed a 3 year long pipeline issue by analyzing and refining deal memos in Stifel’s database. This fixture improved data and allowed for Manager’s to create more effective deals.
- Reviewed and filed monthly sensitive tax reconciliation reports for the IRS.
- Worked in Salesforce/Microsoft office and completed Training the Street Module.
positions.insights: Skills: Finance · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Microsoft Excel · Salesforce.com · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Skills: Financial Analysis · CLO · Microsoft Excel · Economics

positions.title: Caddie
positions.description:
- Did 2 Rounds of Golf every weekend my spring semester senior year of high school.
- Carried players clubs, cleaned equipment, offered advice on the course
- Started my day at 5:30 am for the first tee time
- Attended Charity events
